name: Boris', Sonael'!
source: The story is about a fan apocalypse in which the FruLive vtubers, in particular Sonael, became involved. She will have to break through the crowds of fans, meet with her colleagues and figure out what is happening
translation: 这个故事讲述了FruLive vtuber（尤其是Sonael）卷入的一场粉丝灾难。她必须冲破粉丝群，与同事见面并弄清楚发生了什么
